ValidationRule.description: VR-QLI-01: On auto-NRC lines paired to an MRC, blocks only identity/link changes (Product2Id, Paired_MRC_Line__c, Is_Auto_NRC__c). All editable/cascade updates and no-op re-saves pass. Deletion is guarded by the QLI before-delete trigger.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), Is_Auto_NRC__c = TRUE, NOT(ISBLANK(Paired_MRC_Line__c)), OR( ISCHANGED(Product2Id), ISCHANGED(Paired_MRC_Line__c), ISCHANGED(Is_Auto_NRC__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This installation charge is linked to a service line. Its product and service-line link can't be changed here — edit the paired service line instead, or contact Revenue Ops.
